social_media.headline: Significant Geomagnetic Event Subsiding
social_media.summary: G1–G2 geomagnetic activity and elevated solar particle levels may continue as the significant space weather event subsides.
what_we_know: There is a 60% chance G1–G2 conditions will continue through 0000 UTC Tuesday.
There is a 30% chance G1–G2 conditions will continue beyond 0000 UTC Tuesday.
Confidence is high that G5 activity has ended.
Elevated particle levels may remain a concern for aviation and satellite operations.

footer.left: Partners may begin planning a transition to normal monitoring.

visual.alt_text: Operational visualization for subsiding geomagnetic activity and elevated solar particle levels.
